text: Proposed: the factory works on several issues at once, one step per issue, up to `-parallel` steps at a time, 3 by default. Its clone is changed by one git command at a time, and losing the lease stops every step. The proved models each describe one issue, so every proved rule still holds for each issue, and the scheduler is plumbing, tested with the race detector and a crash test over two overlapping issues. Today one build holds up every other issue: #97 to #103 waited behind #91's.
